name: Athirappilly Waterfalls
blurb: Often called the Niagara of India, this majestic 80-foot waterfall draws nature lovers from afar.

name: Fort Kochi
blurb: Visitors explore colonial-era streets, iconic Chinese fishing nets, and vibrant art galleries.

name: Munnar
blurb: Travelers visit to witness endless rolling green tea plantations, misty mountains, and cool climate.

name: Kumarakom
blurb: A peaceful village on Vembanad Lake famous for bird watching and luxury backwater resorts.

name: Alleppey Backwaters
blurb: Famous for iconic overnight houseboat cruises along tranquil palm-fringed canals and lagoons.

name: Thekkady
blurb: Home to Periyar National Park where tourists enjoy elephant safaris, boat rides, and spice tours.

name: Ooty
blurb: A classic Nilgiri hill station within driving distance from Wayanad, famous for botanical gardens and toy trains.

name: Wayanad
blurb: Renowned for scenic spice plantations, prehistoric caves, waterfalls, and diverse trekking trails.

name: Varkala Beach
blurb: Drawn by unique Cenozoic sedimentary cliffs overlooking the Arabian Sea and bohemian cliffside cafes.

name: Padmanabhaswamy Temple
blurb: An opulent, highly revered shrine dedicated to Lord Vishnu, showcasing intricate Dravidian architecture.

name: Mysore Palace
blurb: A breathtaking royal residence featuring Indo-Saracenic architecture, a short day-trip distance north of Wayanad.

name: Kovalam Beach
blurb: Popular crescent-shaped coastline known for lively beach culture, lighthouses, and Ayurvedic resorts.

name: Coorg
blurb: A fragrant coffee country hill station easily accessible by road from northern Kerala.
